To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a deep convolutional network, when used in combination with linguistic patterns and sentiment analysis, can be successfully employed for aspect extraction.

(1) a 7-layer convolutional neural network, trained with a combination of positive and negative opinionated sentences, is capable of extracting aspects in opinionated text; (2) the combination of the neural network with linguistic patterns improves the accuracy of aspect extraction; (3) the combination of aspect extraction and sentiment analysis, both based on the same word-embedding model, allows the system to identify aspects that are associated with either positive or negative sentiment.
a deep convolutional network is a powerful tool for aspect extraction and that the use of an ensemble classifier can improve performance.

the following contributions: 1) we present the first approach to aspect extraction based on deep learning, 2) we propose a set of linguistic rules for this subtask of sentiment classification, 3) we present the results obtained by our deep learning approach in combination with the linguistic rules and 4) we show that the ensemble classifier is able to outperform all the state-of-the-art approaches to aspect extraction.
